messages:
Clara (Support): FYI — Stratos Merchant (acct: STRAT-004) shows a promo credit applied to a different org. Invoice INV-2026-2421 reflects -$3,740.50 on acct STRAT-009 instead of STRAT-004. Can finance help reverse/apply?

Aisha (Finance Ops): Thanks Clara. Can you paste the invoice line(s) and the external_id that came with the payment? Also want to know whether partner requested a refund vs. credit to next invoice.

Clara (Support): Pasting minimal lines below. Partner confirmed they want a credit applied to their next invoice, not an ACH refund. External ID on payment: pm_78b4e0-stratos-merge.

```
INV-2026-2421 | STRAT-009 | Credit | PROMO-APR24 | -3740.50 | USD | tax 0.00
INV-2026-2421 | STRAT-004 | Usage | API-TOKENS | 3740.50 | USD | tax 0.00
```

Link to screenshot: https://redwood.internal/notes/INV-2421-snap (internal)

BillingBot: recon-job-2026-04-02 completed: matched external_id pm_78b4e0-stratos-merge -> org STRAT-009 (merged legacy mapping). Potential false positive due to historical org merge. Suggest manual adjustment.

Liam (Billing): Looks like the legacy org merge caused the credit to be attributed to STRAT-009. We should: 1) reverse the negative line on STRAT-009, 2) create manual credit on STRAT-004 for $3,740.50, 3) attach memo referencing INV-2026-2421 and the ext_id. Need GL code and tax handling.

Aisha (Finance Ops): Tax is zero here. Proposing manual credit (goodwill type) of $3,740.50 applied to STRAT-004 on next invoice. GL Code: 7550-PartnerCredits. Approver required from finance lead / CFO. @Maya can you sign off?

Maya (CFO): Approved. OK to issue manual credit up to $4,000 for partner operational errors; use GL 7550-PartnerCredits and tag revenue impact in the adjustment note. :white_check_mark:

Eve (Revenue): Quick Q — does this require reversing any previously recognized revenue? If the original invoice was recognized, we should add a reversing journal. If not recognized, just credit. @Aisha can you confirm revenue ops will get a notification?

Aisha (Finance Ops): Good catch. Original invoice recognized in period 2026-03. We'll generate a reversing journal entry code JV-REVERSE-7421 and notify revenue ops. Eve, I'll ping the revenue-ops channel once the JV is queued.

Sanjay (AM): Partner accepts credit to next invoice and wants a short memo they can show their procurement team. Can we include: "Credit issued due to promo misapplication; reference INV-2026-2421; no cash refund" in the memo?

Liam (Billing): Yep — we'll include that memo on the manual credit and the partner-facing invoice note. I'll also update the internal mapping to avoid future ext_id collisions (file ticket in eng).

Aisha (Finance Ops): Actioned: Created manual credit record REF-7421 for STRAT-004, amount $3,740.50, GL 7550-PartnerCredits, JV JV-REVERSE-7421 queued. Partner memo added. Ticket filed for mapping fix: BILL-2984. Will reflect on next invoice cycle.

Clara (Support): Awesome — thanks team. I'll close the support case once partner confirms they see the credit on their next invoice. :thumbsup:

Maya (CFO): Thanks all. Good operational playbook — please keep note of remediation steps in the finance runbook.
